summary: # **CENTRAL ELECTRICITY REGULATORY COMMISSION NEW DELHI** # ** Petition No. 361/MP/2023 along with IA No. 61/2026 ** **Coram:** **Shri Jishnu Barua, Chairperson Shri Ramesh Babu V., Member Shri Harish Dudani, Member Shri Ravinder Singh Dhillon, Member** **Date of Corrigendum Order: 10** **th** **November, 2026** # **In the matter of:** Corrigendum to the order dated 21.7.2026 in Petition No. 361/MP/2023. # **And** # **In the matter of:** Petition under Sections 62 and 79(1)(a) of the Electricity Act, 2003, read with Regulation 29 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Terms and Conditions of Tariff) Regulations, 2019 for the determination of tariff on the installation of various Emission Control Systems in Bokaro-A Thermal Power Station (500 MW) in compliance with the revised Emission Standards. **And** # **In the matter of:** Damodar Valley Corporation, DVC Towers, VIP Road, Kolkata – 700054 **Petitioner** Versus 1. Jharkhand Bijlee Vitaran Nigam Limited, Engineering Building, HEC Township, Dhurwa, Ranchi-834004 2. Punjab State Power Corporation Limited, Inter-State Building Shed No. TI-A, Patiala-147001. 3. West Bengal State Electricity Distribution Company Limited, Vidyut Bhawan, Bidhannagar, Block DJ, Sector-II, Salt Lake City, Kolkata – 700 091 ** Respondents** _Corrigendum to Order in Petition No. 361/MP/2023_ _Page_ **_1_** _of 2_ # ** CORRIGENDUM ORDER ** The Commission, vide Order dated 21.7.2026, determined the tariff for installing various Emission Control Systems at Bokaro-A Thermal Power Station (500 MW) in compliance with the revised Emission Standards. However, it is observed that an inadvertent typographical error has crept into the date of the order. Accordingly, in exercise of powers under Regulation 54 read with Regulation 66 of the Central Electricity Regulatory Commission (Conduct of Business) Regulations, 2023, the inadvertent error is rectified. 2. Accordingly, the date of the Order in Petition No. 361/MP/2023 along with I.A. No. 61/2026 shall be read as **‘12** **th** **October 2026’** instead of **‘21** **st** **July 2026’** . 3. Except for the above, all other contents of the Order shall remain unchanged. **_Sd/Sd/Sd/Sd/-_ (Ravinder Singh Dhillon) (Harish Dudani) (Ramesh Babu V.) (Jishnu Barua) Member Member Member Chairperson** _Corrigendum to Order in Petition No. 361/MP/2023_ _Page_ **_2_** _of 2_ CERC Website S. No. 562/2026
